description: Validation data for publication "Coupled time series of electricity demand, occupancy, weather, and thermal demand for residential buildings is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Markus Doepfert. This is the validation data that was used for the paper's dataset (10.5281/zenodo.22299342). It can also be recreated from the software directly (10.5281/zenodo.22300191). Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
